content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user with a personal to-do list","i_want":"to create a new task with a title, description, priority and due date","so_that":"I can record work I need to do and keep track of when it is due","business_description":"Users create tasks that are saved to the persistence database with a unique ID, a Creation Date and a Status of Open. The title is mandatory, and the Due Date cannot be earlier than the Creation Date. The form reports the result of each create attempt.","business_value":"Users can capture their to-do items in one place with the fields the PRD requires, and the data is valid before it is stored.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"the task creation form is open with a non-empty Title and a Due Date equal to or later than today","when":"the user submits the form","then":"the backend saves a new task with a unique ID, the Creation Date set to the current date, Status Open and the entered fields, and the form shows the message 'Task created'"},{"given":"the task creation form is open with an empty Title","when":"the user submits the form","then":"the backend rejects the request, no task is saved, and the form shows an error message stating that the title is required"},{"given":"a new task with a Creation Date of 2025-06-10","when":"the user submits a Due Date of 2025-06-09","then":"the backend rejects the task, nothing is saved, and the form shows an error message that the Due Date cannot be earlier than the Creation Date"},{"given":"a new task with a Creation Date of 2025-06-10","when":"the user submits a Due Date of 2025-06-10 and a non-empty Title","then":"the backend accepts the task and saves it with that Due Date"},{"given":"the backend returns an error or cannot be reached when the user submits a new task","when":"the request fails","then":"the form shows an error message and does not show the task as created"},{"given":"the task creation form is open","when":"the user opens the Priority selector","then":"only Low, Medium and High can be selected"},{"given":"a task has been saved successfully","when":"the saved task is read with GET /tasks/{id}","then":"the response contains its unique ID, Title, Description, Status, Priority, Creation Date, Due Date and Last Updated Date"},{"given":"tasks exist in the database","when":"a client calls GET /tasks","then":"the response contains all stored tasks with all their fields"},{"given":"no task exists with the ID used in the request","when":"a client calls GET, PUT, DELETE or the status change endpoint for that ID","then":"the backend responds with a task not found error and changes nothing"},{"given":"an existing task with a valid Title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"a client sends the new field values to PUT /tasks/{id}","then":"the backend saves the new values and returns the updated task"},{"given":"an existing task","when":"a client calls DELETE /tasks/{id}","then":"the task is removed and a subsequent GET /tasks/{id} for it returns a task not found error"},{"given":"an existing task with Status Open","when":"a client sends a status change to In Progress to PATCH /tasks/{id}/status","then":"the backend stores the status In Progress and returns the updated task"},{"given":"an existing task","when":"a client sends a status value other than Open, In Progress or Completed","then":"the backend rejects the request and the stored status does not change"},{"given":"the backend fails to save a create, update, delete or status change request","when":"the frontend receives the failure","then":"the frontend shows an error message and does not show the action as successful"}],"edge_cases":["Due Date equal to the Creation Date is allowed because the PRD rejects only dates earlier than the Creation Date.","A Title that contains only spaces: the PRD says the title cannot be empty but does not say whether whitespace counts as empty. Open question.","Priority is not given a default value in the PRD. Open question: must the user choose a priority, and what is stored if none is chosen?","Due Date is not stated as mandatory in the PRD. Open question: can a task be saved without a Due Date?","Description is not stated as mandatory or as having a length limit. Open question.","No maximum length for Title or Description is stated in the PRD. Open question.","The PRD does not state the time zone or the date format used for Creation Date. Open question.","The PRD does not state whether Last Updated Date should equal the Creation Date at creation.
